description: This file defines several interfaces related to grain communication and reentrancy control in an Orleans-based system, including grain interfaces for deadlock scenarios, call chain observation, and reentrancy configurations, as well as an enumeration for reentrancy call types.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Asynchronous method to proceed to the next call in a chain for non-reentrant deadlock grain.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Asynchronous method to proceed to the next call in a chain for non-reentrant deadlock grain.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Asynchronous method to proceed to the next call in a chain for reentrant deadlock grain.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Asynchronous method to proceed to the next call in a chain for reentrant deadlock grain.

methods.name: OnEnter
methods.description: Callback invoked when a call enters a grain, reporting the grain and call index.

methods.name: OnExit
methods.description: Callback invoked when a call exits a grain, reporting the grain and call index.

methods.name: CallChain
methods.description: Method to initiate a call chain with a specified observer, call list, and starting index.

methods.name: UnblockWaiters
methods.description: Method to unblock any waiting callers, marked with AlwaysInterleave attribute.
